notes.title: Internal update v.0.6
notes.content:
Ah.. PGA 2024.. that was an amazing experience! With over 750 players playing and around 40,000 pieces of trash cleaned up from our world, it was both fun and insightful. The event served as a great testing ground, and while the game ran smoothly overall, we did identify a few areas that were more challenging than expected.

We’re excited to share a post-PGA update where we’ve addressed these issues and added localization support.

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you next time!

What’s next? 
We’re focusing on cooperative mechanics, player controller, and enhancing enemy interactions.
